"If we want to be successful, we surely need to have skilled players. But if they cannot work well with each other and the atmosphere in the locker room is cold, then they won't be able to show their full potential. If the locker room is filled with good team spirit, it makes us strong and we can face any opponent. Things that you should be aware of:
If two players with high charisma and difficult temperament will meet each other, they often happen to create a conflict. If these two are together on the pitch, it has a negative impact on the team performance.
Good-tempered and friendly players with high charisma tend to live in good relations. It may even lead to friendships, which is good for us. They understand each other also on the pitch so having them both in the lineup is good for us.
When a new player is coming to the team, he sometimes finds it hard to integrate with the rest, especially when he has a low charisma. This happens even more often to young players and foreigners. Such players won't be able to do their best during matches.
Sometimes you will see that one of the players is very popular with team mates, and they have a lot of respect to him. It will be clear that they want him as a leader. It's a very good choice to make him a captain. However, if you don't choose him to the squad at all, the others will miss him on the pitch and it may have negative impact.
What you can do to improve the atmosphere in the locker room? Why don't you take your team to dinner? Or even to the party? Everyone needs some fun. Of course, everything has also its consequences.
"
